text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
—Oh my, Christmas decorations here too. It 
really is just around the corner, isn't 
it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from shopping, Royce and 
Royce suddenly remarked on that out of the 
blue.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Once Christmas is over, the new year will 
be here in a flash... and that means it 
will have been three years since you and I 
became a team, Trainer.
choice_data_list: Let's see...
Yeahhh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing it put like that makes me feel 
surprisingly sentimental. ...Just as I'm 
lost in nostalgic thoughts—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: —And so, it's time for a test right here!
choice_data_list: Hm!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what are you looking so surprised for? 
Even for us Umamusume, three years is a 
major milestone.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Even if that's what it means for you, 
Trainer, that's totally fine. Milestones 
are important, after all."
choice_data_list: Is that... so?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: That's right. —And on that note, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Show me the self-producing skills you've 
cultivated up to this point!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The topic is—let's see, how we spend 
Christmas! And there you'll be, escorting 
me...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Go on, show me everything you have to 
offer."
choice_data_list: My charm...?
My charm...?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep my whole day open on Christmas. 
I'm counting on you to get things ready♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She had become capable of planning her own 
self-production alone. However, the 
problem was—
choice_data_list: (What is my appeal, anyway...?)
(What is my appeal, anyway...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When asked point-blank like that... 
nothing specific comes to mind.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
However, "I don't know" was not an 
acceptable answer. Desperately racking my 
brain, I kept thinking—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The one single answer finally squeezed 
out. The one single thing about myself I 
can truly say I have confidence in. That 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sheer strength of the desire to 
support Royce and Royce.
choice_data_list:
If it's just that... I won't lose to 
anyone, I'm sure of it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I'll make that appeal through how we spend 
Christmas. In that case, the plan is 
obvious.
choice_data_list:
Let's make this the most fun Christmas 
ever for you, Royce!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now then, today I'll be testing your 
self-producing skills, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"I wonder what kind of charms of yours 
you'll show off to me."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on you! ...So, where are we 
going first?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking of going outdoors after 
this, but... Royce and Royce's cheeks and 
fingertips look a little red.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seemed best to warm up first. Thinking 
that—
choice_data_list: Let's go into that cafe over there!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... What should I get, I wonder? What 
do you recommend, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Maybe hot cocoa. It's sweet, so I think 
you'd like it.

Maybe cocoa. It's sweet, so I think you'd 
like it.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Hot cocoa for me, then. Let's see if your 
skills can make it sweet enough to satisfy 
me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Phew... The sugar is soaking into my 
brain...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It's super-duuuper sweet hot cocoa, just 
the way I like it. How did you know, 
though?
choice_data_list:
With the amount of sugar you always put in 
your latte.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since we'd edited videos together at 
times, I had seen her put sugar into her 
drinks back then.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh, you're pretty observant, aren't you? 
You even made sure to check out the shops 
near the meeting spot.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Observation skills and planning ability... 
I wonder if she was showing off that side 
of herself?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Still... mmm, it's delicious. And it 
warms you right down to your core..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From there, we took the train to today's 
destination. The place was overflowing 
with Christmas spirit—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Oh, isn't that a theme park!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, visiting during a special time 
like this makes it feel even more 
extraordinary and gets me hyped up.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Alright, Trainer-san! What should we ride 
first?
choice_data_list:
The park train, and before that, a photo 
of the castle!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft—Ahaha! Both are Christmas-exclusive 
decorations! That's what the park ad I saw 
earlier said."

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Look at you, doing your homework 
thoroughly. Not bad! I'll give your 
research skills a 'Double Circle'!
choice_data_list: Yeah! So leave the guiding to me!
Yeah! Leave the guiding to me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... You seem to be in rather high 
spirits yourself, Trainer.
choice_data_list: This is a place I've wanted to visit, too.

This is a place I've always wanted to 
visit, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ever since seeing a special TV feature on 
it, I had longed to go there someday. I 
honestly confided that to her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce is a very sharp girl. If 
the person with her isn't fooling around 
with all their might, she tends to notice 
and snap back to being totally 
level-headed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
So today, I chose a place where both of us 
can have fun to our heart's content!
choice_data_list: Let's go, Royce! I can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... hehe, hey now! You can't go 
forgetting what this was all about, okay~?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Well, let's go! Starting with the photos♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Say cheese!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yeah, that came out nicely. Next up is—
choice_data_list: Wanna put on a headband for the photo?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that sounds nice! There was something 
that caught my eye just a moment ago.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer's is—
choice_data_list:
I'd like you to pick something that suits 
you, Royce.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like fun! Ehehe, I wonder what 
would be good♪

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(“Letting me pick out the headband”... You 
really understand my producer instincts, 
don't you!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Was the charm I displayed that I make you 
look good, perhaps?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And just like that, her self-producing was 
going smoothly, until—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That's a bit surprising. You really do 
just hang out and play normally like the 
rest of us, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I was sure we'd be having a Christmas 
lunch at a restaurant or something—
choice_data_list: ...Figures. It is Christmas, after all.
...Figures. It is Christmas, after all.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She surely wants to enjoy that special 
Christmas feeling. That's what I thought, 
but—
choice_data_list: It's already fully booked... I'm sorry!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Wait, did you really... prepare all this 
for me?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Heeeh... I see... So that's how it is...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (...I-I'm happy, but!)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(...Did they even find out that I've been 
dreaming of eating at the park 
restaurant...!?)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Look at her showing off just how 
ridiculously quick on the uptake she 
is...!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Ugh, I'm panicking...! But...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (I really am happy, after all...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
That roller coaster was the best! It's 
scary, but so exhilarating~~~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I heard you let out a little 
'Whoa', Trainer♪
choice_data_list:
No way, anyone would scream on a dive like 
that!

No way, who wouldn't scream on a dive like 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I heard you let out a little 
'Whoa', Trainer♪
choice_data_list:
No way, anyone would scream on a dive like 
that!

No way, who wouldn't scream on a dive like 
that?!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You should've just screamed at the top of 
your lungs like me. Screaming your head 
off is proper etiquette, you know! ☆

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Ah, hey, there's popcorn! Let's eat some!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The limited-edition flavor, or the classic 
caramel... I wonder which one I should go 
with...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to try the limited edition, but 
what if it's not to my taste...?
choice_data_list: Excuse me, could I have a free sample?

text_block_list.name: Park Staff
text_block_list.text:
Yes, certainly. Which flavor would you 
like?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
! I see, free samples were an option...! I 
should have checked—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not right. I was the one 
asking if it was possible, after all...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (It was because I was hesitating...)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(Ah... it's not that Trainer already knows 
everything about me, nor that they've been 
doing tons of research――)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
(She's really watching over me closely, 
isn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: (Always. No matter when, forever.)

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
It got dark before I even realized... Time 
really flies when you're having fun, 
doesn't it?
choice_data_list: Shall we head to the next spot, then?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Huh? There's still another one?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her expression, which had looked so 
reluctant to part, suddenly brightened up.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I see, Christmas cake! Come to think of 
it, we haven't eaten any yet.
choice_data_list:
When it comes to this, I just don't know 
your tastes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It would've been so smooth if I could've 
prepared her favorite cake... but 
honestly, there were just too many kinds 
of cake.
choice_data_list: So let's pick it out together.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: ! ...Fufufu.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"To pull something like this at the very, 
very end... You're quite the tactician, 
aren't you?"
choice_data_list: Huh!? What is?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, she basically respected my 
pace and adapted to me, but... Now things 
have changed.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: "Together"—so that is your wish. Ufufufu!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“Still, now I understand completely— the 
appeal you worked so hard to show me.”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's do our overall review 
while enjoying some cake, shall we?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Now then, regarding your self-producing, 
Trainer-san—

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Your charm... your kindness— it left quite 
an impression on me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You respect my wishes and support me from 
the shadows.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: I was reminded of that once again.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"The reason I was able to have such a fun 
day today was all thanks to your 
thoughtful care!"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Your self-production skills pass with 
flying colors as well, of course! I would 
expect nothing less from my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Please keep supporting me with that 
kindness of yoursâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After picking out a cake together, we 
headed back to the academy. However, the 
final piece of producing still remained.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Someone helped you, right? There's 
no way you did it all alone...
choice_data_list: No, I decorated it all by myself.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Eeeeehhk!?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be kidding me! How many 
hours—no, days did you spend on this?!
choice_data_list: For you, it's no trouble at all
For you, it's no trouble at all

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not just this time, but training guidance, 
and all the self-producing work too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
People sometimes tell me things like video 
editing outside usual Trainer duties must 
be tough, but I've never felt that it was 
tough myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as she would do anything to be the 
"strongest," I, too, would do anything for 
her sake.
choice_data_list: If anything, it was a blast!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Geez... Honestly, you really are something 
else...!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Okay, okay, I get it! Honestly, I don't 
know if I'd call that unexpected or 
just... kind of a foul move to answer with 
that.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
The charm you were appealing with was 
"your feelings for me!" Isn't that right?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Seriously... what can I even 
say.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Just as expected of my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
“Still, you're right. There were quite a 
few things I miscalculated along the way 
this time――”

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"Next year, then. Could I ask you to 
escort me for Christmas again with the 
same theme?"

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
"This time, properly, right from the 
start. —I'll be gazing straight at your 
feelings."
choice_data_list: With pleasure!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It's a promise♡
